_comment: What families, schools and partners pay Optio. The ONE place a price is
written (Tanner, 2026-10-13: 'review all mentions of pricing in the whole
site and app and standardize to one set of pricing').
Before this file the same price was typed into the marketing site, the
Academy agreement and handbook, the Terms of Service, email copy, CRM
funnels, the help center and the microschool pricing sheet, and they had
drifted: the Terms said Full-Time Academy was $8,000 a year while the
agreement said $500 a month, and retired $149 class pages were still live.
Everything here is integer cents. shared/scripts/generate-constants.mjs
emits it for the backend (backend/generated/pricing.py), the web and mobile
apps (shared/generated/pricing.ts) and the marketing site
(marketing/src/data/pricing.generated.ts). Help center articles and CRM
funnel emails live in the database; they write {{price.<name>}} and the
backend fills it in from here when they are served or sent
(backend/utils/pricing_text.py).
The two price lists:
private   a family paying Optio Academy itself.
licensed  a student whose school holds an Optio license for them (any
microschool), and OpenEd families. Every credit is half price.
Change a number here, run `npm run generate` from the repo root, and
commit the JSON with the generated files. The agreement and the Terms of
Service read these values too, so a price change is also a change to legal
text: bump their effective dates in the same commit.

accelerated._comment: A credit beyond the included pace, to finish faster. One price for every student: it is not discounted for a license, for OpenEd or for any program, and it is priced above accrediting transfer credit (Tanner, 2026-10-13).

licensed._comment: A student whose microschool holds an Optio license. Half price for credits earned through Optio and for prior learning Optio Academy accredits. Accelerated credits are not discounted (see accelerated).

transfer._comment: Credit from an accredited school's official transcript is free. Credit from anywhere else (homeschool, co-ops, schools without accreditation) is reviewed and costs unaccreditedCreditCents, one price for every student, private or licensed ($25 per half credit; Tanner, 2026-10-14). The family uploads the transcript on the Prior Learning page in both cases.

openEd._comment: OpenEd families buy from OpenEd's marketplace and OpenEd pays Optio, so the platform never shows them a price (Tanner, 2026-10-13). These are the marketplace products, for reference and for the partner sheet: the year buys creditsIncludedPerYear credits at licensed.creditCents (the generator checks that), prior learning is transfer.unaccreditedCreditCents and accelerated is accelerated.creditCents. OpenEd adds marketplaceFeeHalfCreditCents to each half credit of prior learning as its marketplace fee, so a family pays $30 a half credit there (Tanner, 2026-10-14).
